## What's Changed
* Fix wrapped PR sidebar error description indentation by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/28
* fix: detect repositories in sibling .bare dirs by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/29
* Keep PR sidebar background transparent by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/30
* feat: add Unicode dashboard icon style by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/31
* Fix PR icon and title truncation by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/32
* Use accent color for merged PR icon by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/33
* Use theme primary hue for merged PR icon by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/34
* feat: refine Unicode dashboard icons by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/35
* fix: restore original Nerd Font PR icons by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/37
* fix: align dashboard status messages consistently by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/36
* Remove divider above pagination controls by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/38
* Server-filter PR dashboard pagination by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/39
* Fix dashboard pagination and status UI by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/40
* Mute the no-matching-PR message by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/41
* ci: publish npm releases from GitHub Actions by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/42
* fix: remove sidebar top padding by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/43
* Keep demo pagination counts in sync by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/44
* Document npm install, batched loading and icon styles in README by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/45
* Colour merged PRs with the theme's info colour by default by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/46
* Remove colour and icon keys that no longer have an effect by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/47
* Align dashboard info messages by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/48
* Configure closed and draft PR icons by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/49
* docs: clarify TUI plugin options in cli.json by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/50
* test: run CI against OpenCode 2.3.2 by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/51
* Supplement recent PRs while search indexes by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/52
* fix: expand pagination click targets by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/53
* test: cover nested Git root detection by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/54
* test: cover bounded PR pagination edge cases by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/57
* test: isolate E2E dashboard from GitHub API by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/55
* chore: enable TypeScript unused checks by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/58
* Fix PR merge-readiness status and reviewer counts by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/pull/59
* Polish dashboard scope, theme, and title sizing by @987poiuytrewq in https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/ope

This release records the existing npm publication of opencode-github-pr@0.1.0 (published November 19, 2026). The tag identifies the source snapshot for that already-published package; this archival release does not republish to npm.
